summary.text: Landscape as Before is the killer move Fang Yuan names for his use of Landscape as Before Immortal Gu on Dang Hun Mountain, and later the rank eight compound killer move that rebuilds Reverse Flow River.

claims.text: Fang Yuan restores Dang Hun Mountain with Landscape as Before Immortal Gu, and reasons that what looks on the surface like the use of a Gu worm is equally the killer move landscape as before. In his refinement path understanding every killer move is an unfinished Gu recipe, so the restoration counts as Gu refinement as well. What he is refining is not a Gu worm but Dang Hun Mountain as a rank nine immortal material.

Fang Yuan activates the immortal killer move Landscape as Before. Landscape as Before Immortal Gu is still a time path Immortal Gu at rank eight. The killer move he uses is a compound killer move. It contains profundities of time path, earth path, water path, rule path, soul path, and other paths. Under that compound killer move, Reverse Flow River expands at a rapid pace. After he uses the compound killer move dozens of times, Reverse Flow River, which previously only had a little trace left, becomes a long narrow river.

Landscape as Before’s compound killer move is at rank eight level. The complete Reverse Flow River is a secluded domain of heaven and earth, equivalent to rank nine in quantity of dao marks. At the later stage of recovery, the compound killer move will fall in effectiveness until it becomes negligible.

After healing his body, Fang Yuan activates another compound killer move, Landscape as Before. Year essence pools and sub-pools in the sovereign immortal aperture open their dams. Accumulated water of the River of Time forms a vast silhouette under the effect of landscape as before, sweeping through the mini five regions and the mini nine heavens. Resource points of mountains and rivers are restored. When he created the year essence sub-pools and time path areas, he had already prepared to use landscape as before for this purpose. After this method, the water of the River of Time in the year essence pools is almost used up. Landscape as before is not useful for losses created by the chaotic disaster.
